Usage: prime eval logs [OPTIONS] EVAL_ID

  Get logs for a hosted evaluation.

Positional arguments:
  EVAL_ID  [required]

Arguments:
  EVAL_ID  [required]

Options:
  -n, --tail INTEGER     Number of lines to show  [default: 1000]
  -f, --follow           Follow log output
  --poll-interval FLOAT  Polling interval in seconds when following logs
                         [default: 5.0]
  --plain                Use plain, terse outputs. USE THIS IF YOU ARE AI.
  -h, --help             Show this message and exit.
